subject: planner: fix doesn't push down hash join to tiflash (#60436)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The only planner behavior change is in `PhysicalHashJoin.attach2TaskForMpp`: when MPP shuffle-join children end up with different `hashCols` lengths (likely from exchange optimization dropping some partition cols), it now restores the missing side by enforcing an exchange using the join’s saved child required property (`GetChildReqProps`), instead of immediately returning `base.InvalidTask`. Existing type-alignment logic (`convertPartitionKeysIfNeed`) still runs afterward. Added TPCH Q9 regression coverage to assert the expected TiFlash MPP plan includes hash-join pushdown. No remaining Blocker/High issues identified in the touched planner logic.
